column3: Close to the Hebrew; “I will say of Yahweh” is rendered “to the LORD,” and the rest is punctuated as direct speech.
NASB adds “it is He who”; “fowler” is rendered “trapper,” and “plague of destruction” as “deadly pestilence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a wall” (a protective covering) is rendered “bulwark.”
The Hebrew reads “For you, Yahweh, [are] my refuge; the Most High you have made your dwelling place”; NASB restructures it as one clause, “you have made the LORD, my refuge … your dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “harm” is rendered “evil.”
NASB marks verses 14–16 as God’s speech with quotation marks and adds “therefore”; “he loves” is rendered “he has loved.”
“Length of days” is rendered “a long life.”
